content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Graduation in Library & Information Science Experience: Preferably with one-year of experience or internship Age limit: Maximum 35 years Other conditions: Proficient in MS-Office (word, excel, power point etc.), internet usage, Zoom or any online meeting tool Good Communication proficiency in English (Both written and verbal) and Hindi Drafting Skills Desirable: One-year of experience or internship

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely on contract basis for an initial period of six months Further extensions will be subject to job requirements and performance

content_sections.heading: How Will IIMK Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Screening of applications Shortlisting based on academic and professional details Interview Selection process and interview

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIMK Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Submit application online at https://iimk.ac.in/. Upload photograph, certificates and signature as per format prescribed in the online portal. Apply on or before 17 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Eligible applications would be screened and only shortlisted candidates will be interviewed Time slots will be communicated by e-mail
